I told Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message that the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

That comes from Dana's post in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025, a channel Marcus is in. She wrote that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift. The cause was the same trailer showing up twice: the driver checked in at the kiosk and then dispatch added him manually. Thea's title comes from the signed Quarrendon amendments.

Dana was handling it on our side at the time, and I couldn't see any more recent update on it.
